files.description: Product code changes (150 rows): product (name with model), stock_qty (whole number), old_code and new_code (four-digit whole numbers; the code is unchanged in 100 rows). No empty cells.

task_text: Index the table by old_code so that it can be used as a lookup of the new code. Then add a column unchanged to the original table, True where new_code equals old_code. `result` should be the original table (same rows, same order) with the added column unchanged.
intended_computation: The 150 rows of code_changes.csv with columns product, stock_qty, old_code, new_code and a boolean column unchanged = (new_code == old_code); 100 rows are True.

acceptable_variants.notes: row labels are free; unchanged may be True/False or 1/0.

predicted_direction.reason: Comparing the old_code index with the new_code column gave a plain array on 2.x, assigned by position; on 3.x it is a Series labelled by old codes, which aligns to nothing in the original table and fills the column with missing values.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
